params.usdcToken: Address of the six-decimal ERC-20 token used as currency.        Must be a deployed contract implementing IERC20Metadata with decimals()==6.

returns.expectedCount: The count value to supply as join()'s expectedCount arg                       (equal to the current count; join increments to count+1).

poolLiability(uint256).notice: Unclaimed rebates owed within a pool.

purchaseFirst(uint256,uint256).notice: First participant pays the full price C directly to the provider.         Uses checks-effects-interactions: membership is recorded before the         external token call so a reentrant callback cannot bypass the guard.

quoteJoin(uint256,address).notice: Returns the contribution required for `participant` to join `poolId`         at the current membership count, and the resulting expectedCount to         pass to join(). Returns values that join() will accept without rejection.

shareOf(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Share of participant i when there are n members and the total price is C.         Formula: floor(C/n) + (i < C%n ? 1 : 0)         Invariant: sum_{i=0}^{n-1} shareOf(C,n,i) == C

totalLiability().notice: Global sum of all unclaimed rebates across every pool.
